question: Compare the top 3 open-source vector databases for a startup building RAG products.
short_answer: Milvus is an open-source vector database designed for scalable similarity search. Distributed operation adds infrastructure and operational considerations. [S1] Qdrant documentation describes vector search, payload filtering and deployment options. Benchmarking with the intended workload is necessary before choosing a database. [S2] A vector database stores vectors and supports similarity searches. Approximate nearest-neighbor indexing trades exactness for retrieval speed. [S3]

Milvus documentation describes standalone and distributed deployment options for vector search workloads.
Weaviate documentation describes hybrid search, combining keyword and vector search scores.
Weaviate is a vector database that supports vector search and hybrid search combining keyword and vector retrieval.
